state_transition_contract_to_lock.completed_sale: Only actually filled full-position SELL closing a genuinely funded BUY cycle; SELL intent/pending, deadline, supportbreak, unfilled SELL, failed BUY and virtual planned slot are not close events.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.BASE: No added pause. Cost rule and other original decisions unchanged.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.AFTER_NET_LOSS_SKIP1: At each actual completed SELL, set armed from that completed cycle strict realized net<0. Positive/zero net does not arm. One SELL event can arm only once.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.AFTER_ANY_CLOSE_SKIP1: Every actual completed SELL arms one skip, including profitable/zero closes; this competes with loss-selective information using the same waiting action.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.consume: When flat and first original eligible BUY candidateD occurs while armed, suppress that intent, target=0 and consume exactly one planned opportunity slot: reservation=i+11. Clear armed on consumption. No order, actual entry/deadline/cost/peak, fee or failedBUY is created.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.after_consumption: Do not re-arm from a persistent last_loss flag. Remain governed by the planned reservation until expiry, then original candidate rule applies with no repeated pause unless a later genuinely completed SELL arms it.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.existing_reservation: A completed sale before original actual-entry reservation expiry arms state but does not shorten the old reservation. Consume only at the first date on which the original candidate is eligible. If original pending lasts beyond expiry, wait for actual sale; do not consume while held.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.same_D: An actual SELL completed by D close is D-known. If the original strategy is already eligible for a new BUY at that D close, the armed skip can consume then; this affects only next-session execution, never the already completed D sale.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.priority: Inherited pending/mandatory deadline and original cost/shock/support exits are preserved; added state changes only the flat new-BUY branch.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.continuous_history: No year/date switch or reset. Suppressed candidate is not classified using hypothetical next-session fill/status or future profitability. Every profile is a full cash-funded continuous path.
state_transition_contract_to_lock.root_followup_note: Unlike the earlier tentative count-of-consecutive-loss family, these proposed profiles use the most recently actually completed cycle, one-shot arming and one original planned H10 opportunity. No count threshold or extra pause-window scan is needed.

net_loss_definition_and_units.required_oracle: For every actual CLOSED cycle, independently match all positive-quantity actual entry/exit fills and exact charged fees; compare strict sign against actual net cash PnL and ledger trades.net_return. Do not infer loss from D close mark or aggregate annual loss.
net_loss_definition_and_units.cancellation_condition: Per-unit sign cancellation requires equal positive full-position entry/exit quantity and the original proportional-fee semantics. Cash/fee rounding and exact zero boundaries must be checked from actual ledgers; never add an epsilon or let fixed100-unit shadow count a non-funded trade.
net_loss_definition_and_units.price_basis: Runtime inputs/fill reconstruction HFQ_RESEARCH; ledger anchoredHFQ/RESEARCH_UNIT with original anchor5.892. Apply the authenticated projection before price/cash comparison. This preserves existing research treatment of adjustments; do not insert a new dividend/corporate-action/accounting model.
net_loss_definition_and_units.realized_time: Outcome becomes known only after the closing fill actually occurred, no earlier than the fill date. Completed result trades are an audit oracle, not a future-complete input to the strategy.
